The '''loirbnigg''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]], [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to [[Frisal]], a reserve [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="PC" /> for wealthy [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] families.<ref name="CSWE I">{{CSWECite|I|296|Frisal}}</ref> There, the eight-[[Limb/Legends|legged]] creature<ref name="PC" /> was bred<ref name="CSWE I" /> and trained as a riding animal.<ref name="CSWE II">{{CSWECite|II|259|Loirbnigg}}</ref> They were ridden by youth of the [[Atrisia/Legends|Atrisian]] [[Noble/Legends|noble]] families, such as [[Villis Andal]], who later became the Imperial [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]].<ref name="PC" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[John Terra]] created the loirbnigg for ''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume Three]]'', published by [[West End Games]] in [[1993]].<ref name="PC" />
